name: Green Acres Progression Park
notes: Woodward Progression Parks feature beginner-friendly jumps, boxes, and rails designed to help riders build skills and progress confidently.

name: Copperopolis
notes: Closed, to public access, open for private race training.

name: Superpipe on Main Vein
notes: The 22' Superpipe is a premier performance zone near Center Village, hosting major events like the Toyota U.S. Grand Prix and Rev Tour.

name: Summer Hike Park
notes: Open 10am-5pm Fri-Sun every summer starting in late May, as long as the snow conditions! Currently closed.

name: Central Park on Loverly
notes: Central Park, a performance Woodward Mountain Park zone which features medium and large-sized jumps, box and rail features, will challenge and excite skiers and snowboarders from intermediate to pro-level.

name: Red's Backyard on Loverly Lane
notes: Red’s Backyard is a rail zone inspired by Olympian Red Gerard’s home setup, offering rails of various difficulty for creative, freestyle-focused skiing and snowboarding sessions.

name: Pipe Dream on Vein Glory
notes: Pipe Dream is a performance Woodward Mountain Park zone which features a 13’ intro half pipe for shredders to learn and progress.

name: Family Cross on High Point
notes: Woodward Family Cross is a gentle, family-friendly course with banked turns and rollers, offering a fun step up from regular groomed runs.
